verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Zulip acting as an MCP client or letting users plug in MCP servers so the product can call their tools. The bot framework, Botserver, native integrations, incoming webhooks and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks or adjacent features. They are not an MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
